title: A module of shapes
description:
Write a module that returns a table, with private helpers.

```
local shapes = require("shapes")
shapes.circle(1):area()      -> 3.14
shapes.rect(2, 3):area()     -> 6
shapes.total({ ... })        -> 9.14
shapes.round is private: nil
```
hints: Give each shape a shared metatable with an `area` method, the same way as a class (lesson 5.05).
`require` runs the file once and caches the result in `package.loaded`, so two `require`s give the same table.
requirements: `shapes.lua` builds a local table `M`, adds `circle`, `rect` and `total`, and returns `M`.
Helper functions are `local`, so they cannot be reached from outside.
stretch: Add a `register(name, area_fn)` so other modules can add new shapes.
